sessions.title: A Alternatives to do and get
sessions.description_vi: Sử dụng các cụm từ thay thế cho 'do' và 'get' để cải thiện văn phong viết.
sessions.value:
# Study and learning

## A Alternatives to do and get

You can improve your written style by using alternative collocations instead of **do** and **get**.

| expression with do/get             | alternatives                                                                             |
| ---------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| do an exam                         | I have to **sit/take an exam** in biology at the end of term.                            |
| do research, do a research project | Our class **carried out / conducted a research project** into the history of our school. |
| do a course                        | I decided to **enrol on / take a course** in Computer programming.                       |
| do a degree/diploma                | She **studied for / took a degree** in Engineering.                                      |
| do a subject (e.g. law)            | I **studied/took** history and economics in high school.                                 |
| do an essay/assignment             | All students have to **write an essay/assignment** at the end of term.                   |
| do a lecture/talk                  | Professor Parkinson **gave a lecture** on the American Civil War.                        |
| get a degree/diploma               | He **obtained / was awarded a diploma** in Town Planning in 2010.                        |
| get a grade                        | Her essay **received / was given an A-grade**.                                           |
| get a qualification                | You will need to **obtain/acquire a qualification** in social work.                      |
| get an education                   | The country is poor; only 27% of children **receive a basic education**.

**Common mistakes**

Don't confuse **pass an exam** with **sit/take an exam**. _Pass_ means to be successful in an exam or test. Say 'I did my homework', NOT 'I made my homework.'

sessions.title: B
sessions.description_vi: Quan sát cách giáo viên sử dụng các cụm từ trang trọng hơn để lặp lại lời nói của học sinh.
sessions.value:
# Study and learning

## B

Look at these conversations between a teacher and students. Note how the teacher uses more formal collocations to repeat what each student says.

**Student:** Do we have to go to all the lectures to do the course or just yours?

**Teacher:** You must **attend lectures** to **complete course**.

**Student:** Excuse me. Where will next week's **class be held**? In this room?

**Teacher:** No. Next week's class will be held in Room 405.

**Student:** When do we have to **hand in essays**?

**Teacher:** You have to **hand in essays** on Friday.

**Student:** When do we have to **submit application**?

**Teacher:** You have to **submit application** by December 1st.

**Student:** What do I have to do if I want to leave the course?

**Teacher:** If you want to **withdraw from course**, you have to go to the College Office.

sessions.title: C More collocations connected with study and learning
sessions.description_vi: Tìm hiểu thêm các cụm từ liên quan đến học tập và nghiên cứu.
sessions.value:
# Study and learning

## C More collocations connected with study and learning

Do you **keep vocabulary notebook**? It's a good way of **recording collocations**.

I did the **first draft** of my essay last week and the **final draft** this week. I have to **hand in essay** tomorrow.

Then the teacher **gives feedback** after about a week.

We don't have exams at my school. We have **continuous assessment**. [system where the quality of a student's work is judged by pieces of course work and not by one final examination]

The local **technical college** provides training for young people in a variety of professions.

After secondary school, 30% of the population go on to **higher/tertiary education**, and 20% of adults do some sort of **further education course** during their lives.

Does your government **recognise qualifications** for school teachers?
